# Generators

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs — do not edit by hand -->

Use a generator anywhere a blueprint is accepted: `mcb preview gen:<name> -p key=value …`,
`mcb build gen:<name> …`, JSON `{ "generator": "<name>", "params": { … } }` / `parts`, or
`ctx.gen('<name>', { … })` inside a JS blueprint.

Conventions: `y = 0` is the first layer above the ground, the footprint's north-west corner is at
`x = z = 0`, and the front (door, facade, readable text) faces **south**. Every generator is
deterministic; `-p seed=N` varies the random details.

## `arch`

Elliptical arch / gateway; the opening faces north-south, stairs smooth the curves

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `width` | int (3…128) | `9` | outer width along X |
| `height` | int (2…128) | `8` | outer height |
| `depth` | int (1…64) | `2` | thickness along Z |
| `thickness` | int (1…32) | `2` | thickness of the arch ring |
| `material` | block | `"stone_bricks"` | block to build with |
| `smooth` | bool | `true` | smooth the curves with stairs (if the material has stairs) |

```bash
mcb preview gen:arch -o arch.png
```

## `bridge`

Bridge along X: stone arch, beam with piers, or suspension with towers and cables; railings and lanterns. The deck is at y=0 (bank level) and the structure reaches `clearance` blocks below it — place it across a river or gap

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `length` | int (6…256) | `24` | span along X |
| `width` | int (3…24) | `5` | deck width incl. railings |
| `material` | block | `"stone_bricks"` | structure (arch ring, piers, towers) |
| `deck` | block | `"spruce_planks"` | walking surface |
| `style` | enum (arch \| beam \| suspension) | `"arch"` | structural type |
| `clearance` | int (0…64) | `0` | depth below the deck (0 = auto) |
| `railings` | bool | `true` | railings on both edges |
| `lights` | bool | `true` | lanterns along the railings |

```bash
mcb preview gen:bridge -o bridge.png
```

## `house`

Cozy timber-framed house: gable/hip/flat roof, windows, door on the south, chimney, lights, furniture

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `style` | enum (classic \| medieval \| rustic \| modern) | `"classic"` | material preset (explicit params override it): classic = red walls; medieval = white walls, dark-oak frame; rustic = spruce cabin; modern = white concrete, flat roof |
| `width` | int (5…48) | `8` | wall footprint along X (the eaves add `overhang` on each side) |
| `depth` | int (5…48) | `8` | wall footprint along Z (the eaves add `overhang` on each side) |
| `height` | int (4…24) | `5` | wall height incl. the foundation course (≥9 → 2 storeys, ≥13 → 3) |
| `wall` | block | `"red_concrete"` | wall infill (try white_terracotta, spruce_planks, cobblestone, bricks) |
| `roof` | block | `"dark_oak_planks"` | roof material — its stairs/slabs are used (no stairs → stepped roof) |
| `floor` | block | `"stone_bricks"` | interior floor |
| `roofStyle` | enum (gable \| hip \| flat) | `"gable"` | roof shape |
| `ridge` | enum (auto \| x \| z) | `"auto"` | gable ridge direction (auto: along the longer side, front gable when square) |
| `trim` | block | `""` | corner posts / beams (default: stripped log matching the roof wood) |
| `foundation` | block | `"cobblestone"` | foundation course at y=0 |
| `door` | block | `""` | door material (default: matches the trim wood) |
| `glass` | block | `"glass_pane"` | window block |
| `windows` | bool | `true` | windows on all sides |
| `shutters` | bool | `true` | window sills and shutters |
| `overhang` | int (0…3) | `1` | roof overhang (eaves) |
| `chimney` | bool | `true` | brick chimney with campfire smoke |
| `lights` | bool | `true` | lanterns by the door and inside |
| `interior` | bool | `true` | furniture: bed, chest, crafting table, table & chairs, carpet |

```bash
mcb preview gen:house -o house.png
```

## `pixelart`

Pixel art from a PNG/JPEG (CIEDE2000 colour matching, Floyd–Steinberg dithering); vertical faces south

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `image` | string | `""` | path to a .png / .jpg (empty = built-in demo picture) |
| `width` | int (1…1024) | `64` | width in blocks |
| `height` | int (0…1024) | `0` | height in blocks (0 = keep aspect ratio) |
| `palette` | enum (concrete \| wool \| terracotta \| concrete+wool \| full) | `"concrete"` | blocks to use (full ≈ 110 solid blocks) |
| `dither` | bool | `true` | Floyd–Steinberg dithering |
| `plane` | enum (vertical \| flat) | `"vertical"` | wall facing south, or a floor (top of image = north) |
| `alphaThreshold` | int (0…255) | `128` | pixels more transparent than this are skipped |
| `background` | block | `""` | block for transparent pixels (empty = leave untouched) |

```bash
mcb preview gen:pixelart -o pixelart.png
```

## `text`

Block letters (5×7 or 3×5 font), vertical sign or flat on the ground, readable from the chosen side

| Param | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | text | `"HELLO"` | the text (a literal "\n" starts a new line) |
| `block` | block | `"gold_block"` | letter block |
| `font` | enum (5x7 \| 3x5) | `"5x7"` | bitmap font |
| `scale` | int (1…16) | `1` | pixel size in blocks |
| `facing` | enum (south \| north \| east \| west) | `"south"` | side the text is read from |
| `plane` | enum (vertical \| flat) | `"vertical"` | standing sign or lying on the ground |
| `background` | block | `""` | background block (empty = none) |
| `padding` | int (0…32) | `0` | background margin around the text |
| `depth` | int (1…16) | `1` | letter thickness (letters stand out from the background) |
| `spacing` | int (0…8) | `1` | gap between letters (in font pixels) |
| `lineSpacing` | int (0…16) | `2` | gap between lines (in font pixels) |
| `align` | enum (left \| center \| right) | `"center"` | alignment of multi-line text |

```bash

```
